title: Turning down Louis Armstrong and Scobey to stay home
summary: Hodes says Louis Armstrong's band offered him a job three times. He declined to travel and Scobey offered him a quartet instead.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Anyway, at that time she was very normal and anxious for me to know her stuff. And went over it with her and everything. Four days, I fitted right in the band. But I told them I didn't want to stay, because I says, I can't join you because you're going to get up and move. And I'm not travelling that much. I had three offers from Louis Armstrong to join him.

And I have to think that I have Barney Bigard to thank for it. And the band -- whoever -- Frenchie, Frenchie looked at me and says, you belong in that scene. See, Earl had left, and before Joe Sullivan came in, they wanted me. And after Joe Sullivan came in they wanted me. So this is pre-Napoleon.
I didn't know Joe had played with --
Yeah, he played there for awhile. And they wanted me in that, but I didn't want to travel. I decided,
if I go with him, then I no longer can decide my fate. I might not come back to Chicago for two years, and what am I going to do with my family? I got kids and everything. I can't do it.
